Text:
Of the many fabulous accounts of Alexander the Great’s experiences I love this one very much ♥️

When Alexander arrived to Harum, the City of Women, he was taken to the ruling queen and her handmaidens. She told him that only women could live in the city, but that they fulfilled all roles, why one of their breasts was covered with silk and the other with armour. He also learned that the women had to leave the city when they married, but were obliged to send their daughters back. 

Alexander is seen twice in the illustrations of this old, Indian manuscript. At the top, before he arrives to Harum, where he passes a dying person in a richly decorated bed, reminding him of his own mortality, and, below, where he meets the queen in her pavilion ✨
